answer: By the pulse of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The harbor is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the ocean. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, weighted by independent path length, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
